## What this license does not cover

The **prompt-engineering toolkit and the hypershot technique** that this skill
applies are the work of [Matthew Murphy](https://github.com/gusthemole),
published as the Lexideck prompt engineering curriculum. This repository's
contribution is the application of that toolkit to the Claude Code sub-agent
boundary, and the probe evidence for how that boundary behaves. Credit the
source of the method, not just the application.

The **Claude Code sub-agent mechanics** described in the findings are Anthropic's
product behavior, documented at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents.
Observations about that behavior are ours; the behavior is theirs.
